thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/chat-generation > 2s in region us-east-2; queueing rising and kv_cache evictions spiking. Paging tammy (oncall).

 tammy (oncall): ack. seeing p50 80ms p95 600ms p99 2.1s. Queue depth jump at 15:07 UTC. Checking pods.

 omar (infra): node GPUs nominal. Router pods show inflight queues ~520 each, overall queue ~2200. KV cache evictions increased from ~30/s -> 380/s. suspect batch-window heuristic instability after r2140.

 leah (ml-infra): logs show microbatch oscillation: bursts of tiny requests followed by sudden big batches (1->48). jitter causing KV keyset churn and frequent evictions.

 tammy (oncall): any deploys in last hour? @deploy-bot

 deploy-bot: r2140 promoted at 14:50 UTC to inference-router canary (4/8). Change: adaptive_batch threshold refactor + new stability flags.

 leah (ml-infra): I can reproduce locally with synthetic high-concurrency short-req pattern. The new stability flag is overaggressive on growth and underclamps the min window.

 tammy (oncall): proposed immediate mitigation: tighten windows and clamp microbatch_max to 12, increase eviction aggressiveness. Try as hotpatch to canary.

 omar (infra): applying env overrides to canary:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-router ADAPTIVE_MIN_MS=6 ADAPTIVE_MAX_MS=30 ADAPT_GROWTH=1.25 MICRO_MAX=12 KV_EVICT_RATIO=0.7
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-router -n inference
```

 omar (infra): canary updated 15:16 UTC. Observing metrics.

 tammy (oncall): posting to #support: "We're mitigating a latency spike in us-east-2 affecting a subset of generation requests. Mitigation in progress; some customers may see transient 5xxs." :megaphone: 

 hana (support): noted. Alerted enterprise champs (delta-retail, gamma-ai). We'll open tickets if errors persist.

 omar (infra): canary metrics: p99 down 2.1s -> 640ms, queue on canary pods down from 600->180, kv evictions down 380->70/s. Good.

 leah (ml-infra): microbatch distribution stable around 3-10 now. Running longer soak on canary.

 tammy (oncall): rolling overrides to rest of routers with 30s pause between pods. Watch for regressions.

 omar (infra): rolling 15:22->15:28 UTC. Roll complete.

 tammy (oncall): cluster metrics after roll: p50 70ms p95 210ms p99 610ms. Queue overall ~340. Error rate back to baseline. Mitigation successful.

 leah (ml-infra): follow-ups: revert r2140 or patch the heuristic. Add unit/integration test that synthetic short-heavy workload triggers threshold checks. Add KV eviction trace logging.

 tammy (oncall): customer impact: Rated S2. Approx 1.8% of requests affected in us-east-2 during 15:05-15:28 UTC. Two enterprise tenants saw increased 5xx; no data corruption.

 hana (support): delta-retail requested timeline and action plan; agreed to follow-up postmortem.

 tammy (oncall): handing off to @ryan (oncall-next) at 16:00 UTC. Owners: leah - evals/telemetry, omar - emergency knobs, devops - canary gating. I'll draft postmortem.

 ryan (oncall-next): ack, taking watch. Ping me if anything flares.

 tammy (oncall): incident-bot mark mitigated at 15:40 UTC. Closing active pager. Converting to postmortem thread.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem, tighter canary thresholds, emergency microbatch clamp knob.

 tammy (oncall): /end thread
